wire: Six AWG30 finely stranded copper conductors, insulation OD <=0.7 mm, loose braid
scope: A-pose centreline routing guides checked with actual rigid solids and full estimated bundle diameter. Length budget covers finite endpoint travel, plus pi*10 mm bending allowance and 20 mm dressing reserve on every moving span. Guide corners do not define bent wire geometry. Reserved slack must be dressed as smooth service loops outside hinge pinch zones. This is not a flexible-body collision, bend-cycle, fatigue or all-pose cable clearance proof. Clamp each span at both anchors; never pull wire taut.
